judgement.reason: Harbor is a stack of cooperating services (core, jobservice, registry, portal, db, log and others) built from separate images, and Deployz runs only one web service per deployment; the selected Dockerfile builds only the portal frontend.

evidence.quote: Harbor extends the open source Docker Distribution by adding the functionalities usually required by users such as security, identity and management.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: make/photon/ holds the Dockerfiles of 14 component images (common, core, db, exporter, jobservice, log), so the app is a stack of cooperating services. Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: Harbor is a stack of cooperating component services (core, jobservice, registry, db and others), and the selected Dockerfile only builds the static portal frontend, so nothing shown proves that the production app runs as one web process.
